<!-- scene 1 -->
The archive smelled of brine and old glue. Ada Quill was already talking when Mara reached
the top of the stairs, as if the conversation had started without her and would end without
her too.

"Different ink," Ada said at last, tapping a ledger spine. "Nobody ever asks about that."
<!-- scene 2 -->
From the archive window the clock tower was a black thumb against the sky.
